dataset: Taiwan FDA open dataset 188 (食品追溯追蹤系統消費者查詢資料集)
owner_approval: Owner approved the CSV zip (about 2.5 MB) on 17 October 2026.
storage: Kept outside the repository (private evaluation folder); only this record and rendered synthetic development cases are committed.
attribution: Contains data from Taiwan Food and Drug Administration, Ministry of Health and Welfare, open dataset 188, used under the Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
caveat: Values are supplied by manufacturers and are not guaranteed by the FDA. A row is used only if every 營養標示 field is structured and the row passes the internal-consistency checks in arithmetic.py; cases rendered from it are labelled synthetic.
fields_absent: The dataset has no dietary fibre column, so the Taiwan fibre energy form is not exercised by these cases.
